description: During plaud-ingest, step-02's trigger call for recording d6e687e2b0d0a74baba20d28fa1832b4 returned status -12; the step was marked complete and the run moved on, leaving that recording with no outcome until step-06's reconcile flagged it as a silent drop.
correction: On the reconcile's silent-drop flag, re-checked the recording, found the fetch script had re-triggered it and Plaud had finished the transcript, then fetched, speaker-ID'd, ingested and filed it so the run ended with zero silent drops.
systemic_fix: A non-success trigger status in plaud-ingest step-02 must be recorded as an explicit per-recording outcome (retry, failed, or skipped-with-reason) rather than absorbed into a completed step; step-06's reconcile should then be a confirmation, not the first line of defense.
